# Expo Launch

> Launch anything to the App Store, all from your browser.

Important Notes:
- Launch works with mobile apps in public GitHub repositories.
- Users have to open Launch in their browser to launch their app.

## Examples
- https://launch.expo.dev/
- https://launch.expo.dev/?github={repository_url}

## Docs
- [https://launch.expo.dev/llms-full.txt](https://launch.expo.dev/llms-full.txt)
